verdict.rationale: USPTO does run its own machine interfaces. Patent Center documents direct API calls against its Workbench/view-applications surfaces, and api.uspto.gov answers with a structured API-key auth challenge. However, nothing shows that the core UI actions (filing applications, paying fees, responding to office actions, recording assignments, docketing) are available through the API. The rich UI feature set is documented only as web or paper workflows. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for filing, payment and correspondence actions; readable published API reference (OpenAPI, llms.txt); an explicit parity statement; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: For users making direct API calls to Workbench/view applications, this update required a change to the version level of the APIs within Workbench/view applications.
a real machine endpoint that answers unauthenticated requests with a structured auth challenge: an API-key model, not a bot wall.
